title: Ondo button
description: Flat, quiet buttons with an 8px radius in three heights (36, 44 and 48px): a solid fill in the primary colour (near-black on light, pale grey inside dark bands) that dims to 80% on hover, and a soft translucent variant for secondary actions like 'Read more'.
notes: inside a block with the dark class the solid button turns pale grey with black text, as on the original's black bands
